rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying something is certain or will happen without fail.

example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 jat1 ding6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this for an emphatic, often responsive “of course” or “surely,” rather than a neutral statement of certainty.

example.english: Do you want to go? Surely I do!
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 heoi3 gang2 hai6 soeng2 laa1

rows.note: Use this colloquial adverb when confidently predicting that something will happen or be true.

example.english: I will surely win this time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 sat6 wui5 jeng4
